extension.summary: Focus helper and logo matte detector for Arctic Fuse 3
Arctic Fuse 3 焦点助手与 logo 黑底检测
extension.description: Focuses the currently playing or last played episode in the OSD playlist and poster wall, and flags black-matted JPEG clearlogos so the skin can fall back to a transparent logo.
在 OSD 播放列表与海报墙中定位当前/上次播放的剧集；并检测带黑底的 JPEG clearlogo，供皮肤回退到透明 logo。
